simple.meaning: אַרְבָּעִים (ʼarbâʻîym) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “forty.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 135 times across Genesis, Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, and 8 more, beginning at Genesis 5:13. Its contexts include family, family line, righteousness, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַרְבָּעִים (H705).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
